title: Windows audio player: a glass desktop widget
lead: A small translucent player that sits on the desktop and builds a library from your folders.

hero.caption: Installation in three steps: one file of about 2 MB, no administrator rights needed.
hero.alt: Installation in three steps: one file of about 2 MB, no administrator rights needed.

problem: Music lives in folders on a computer. Big players are heavy and cover half the screen, and a browser tab gets lost or gets in the way. A player should always be at hand, take up a corner of the desktop and understand folders the way they are laid out.
built: A desktop widget: translucent glass with adjustable transparency; it stays put when you press show desktop (Win+D) and remembers its position.
A library from your folders: a folder is a playlist, subfolders are albums, covers come from a cover.jpg file or the tags, and search covers all music.
Playlists, Favorites, a queue (drag to reorder, play next), shuffle, repeat.
Its own audio engine: mp3, flac (up to 96 kHz / 24 bit), m4a/aac, ogg, wav, aiff.
Windows integration: media keys, the system volume overlay, a tray icon, autostart, and Open with Carina (the player's name) plays the whole folder from the chosen track.

steps: Point the player at your music folders.
The widget stays in the corner; the music panel opens from it.
Media keys, tray and autostart work like a native app.
offer: Adapting the player to you: look, colors, names, the buttons and features you need.
Or a new app in a similar style (widget plus panel) built around your task.
A small installer (about 2 MB) that needs no administrator rights.
not_included: Hosting, domain and third-party service fees.
